rules.title: Rapid sequential ID enumeration
Rapid sequential ID enumeration
rules.text:
# Rapid sequential ID enumeration
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@streq GET" "id:1748085,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,msg:'Rapid sequential ID enumeration',chain"
    SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "@rx (?i)^/(shipments|customers|drivers)/[A-Z0-9-]+$" "t:none,chain"
    SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:User-Agent "@rx (?i)AppleWebKit/537\.36 \(KHTML" "t:none"

rules.title: Rapid sequential ID enumeration
rules.text:
title: 'Rapid sequential ID enumeration'
id: a5f25475-a595-5acd-922d-2840658c6034
status: experimental
description: 'Matches the automated crawl pattern: rapid sequential requests to resource-specific endpoints (shipments/PRO-, customers/101-110, drivers/E10) using a distinctive scanner User-Agent (AppleWebKit/537.3'
author: Mirage honeypot analyst
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: GET
    c-uri|re: '(?i)^/(shipments|customers|drivers)/[A-Z0-9-]+$'
    cs-user-agent|re: '(?i)AppleWebKit/537\.36 \(KHTML'
  condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.t1595.002

rules.title: Credential stuffing with common weak passwords
rules.text:
# Credential stuffing with common weak passwords
# Matches POST requests to the login endpoint submitting well-known default or weak credential pairs (admin/admin, admin/password, admin/123456, root/toor, administrator/Welcome1, test/test) which are c
# not expressible in stock nginx (needs request-body inspection); use the ModSecurity rule

rules.title: Credential stuffing with common weak passwords
rules.text:
# Credential stuffing with common weak passwords
# requires: SecRequestBodyAccess On
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@streq POST" "id:1529789,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,msg:'Credential stuffing with common weak passwords',chain"
    SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "@rx (?i)^/login$" "t:none,chain"
    SecRule REQUEST_BODY "@rx (?i)username=(admin|root|administrator|test)&password=(admin|password|123456|toor|Welcome1|test)" "t:none,t:urlDecodeUni"

rules.title: Injection payloads on auth endpoints
Injection payloads on auth endpoints
rules.text:
# Injection payloads on auth endpoints
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@streq GET" "id:1283502,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,msg:'Injection payloads on auth endpoints',chain"
    SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "@rx (?i)^/(admin|login)/?$" "t:none,chain"
    SecRule QUERY_STRING "@rx (?i)(\b|[?&])(id|file|q)=([^&]*(\'|\.\./|<script|alert\())" "t:none,t:urlDecodeUni"
